vadoma.look: Vadoma, a Vistani trader woman in her forties: olive skin, dark greying hair braided under a deep green headscarf, heavy gold hoop earrings and rings on every finger, a long dark blue coat embroidered with small gold suns and eyes worn open over an ochre vest and cream blouse, a wide sash hung with little pouches, a leather-bound ledger tucked into the sash, a dark brown skirt and worn travelling boots
vadoma.windup: a short curved knife drawn back beside her hip in one hand, weight on her back foot, coat swinging
vadoma.strike: the knife slashed forward across her body at the enemy, leaning in
